officialStats.limitation: Tracked official-stat files predate per-source refresh manifests; exact fetch time and row-level change history are unavailable.

rosterProjectionInputs.limitation: Current roster context is newer than the frozen model-training inputs; training was not silently refitted.

transactions.limitation: Official transaction ledger through the stated event date. Draft-consideration events are not player signings. The current official roster index remains authoritative for roster membership; transaction text does not establish medical clearance or silently alter forecasts.

injuries.limitation: Dated official game-specific injury report. Unsubmitted teams and players absent from the report are not medical clearance. Upcoming Out listings affect remaining-season expected appearances only; no recovery duration is inferred.

news.limitation: Latest ESPN NBA feed, up to 50 articles. Only explicitly tagged athlete names are joined; no article is not evidence that no news exists.

basketballReferenceSnapshot.limitation: Static second-source snapshot; it is not refreshed by the official-stats reload.

performanceGrades.label: Performance grades and custom metrics

inputVersion.interactiveConfiguration: Custom score uses up to four user-selected fields and weights, tied within-cohort percentiles, missing-ingredient renormalization and explicit mixed-scope consent; configuration and cohort/filter state are preserved in the browser URL.

performanceGrades.source: 2025-26 official NBA/G League stat snapshots with explicitly labeled Basketball-Reference second-source fields

projections.label: 2026-27 player projections
projections.source: Frozen projection inputs/model card plus the published current-roster context

tulipEvidence.label: TULIP role evidence
tulipEvidence.source: Published season/player history and current database rows; unavailable availability/transaction/lineup evidence stays unavailable

tulipBeta.label: TULIP Beta recommended-minute allocator
tulipBeta.source: 2025-26 player value/workload evidence grouped by the published 2026-27 roster snapshot

projectedRoleMpg.label: Projected Role MPG
projectedRoleMpg.source: Frozen historical offseason-move role model and its preserved/recomputed source cache, explicitly not a physical-capacity estimate

playerComparisons.label: Historical player comparisons
playerComparisons.source: Same-league historical profiles, official combine measurements where present, and published player-season evidence

teamFit.label: Skill profiles, similarity, archetypes and Team Fit

inputVersion.interactiveConfiguration: Selected league, player, fields, weights, ranking cohort, filters and mixed-scope permission are user inputs preserved in the browser URL; not fitted model parameters.

teamFit.source: Published same-league player rows and minutes-weighted roster need profiles

crossLeague.label: G League/NBA readiness and translation models
crossLeague.source: Same-season dual-league player sample with explicitly reported sample thresholds and held-out limitations

evidenceClaims.policy: Predictive accuracy may be labeled supported only when a chronological as-of evaluation names the exact shipped model version and evaluates the full shipped model scope.

performanceGrades.boundary: Within-league descriptive performance grades are not forecasts and carry no predictive-accuracy claim.

legacyBacktest.boundary: Legacy veteran projection backtest; it predates the complete current context stack and does not validate rookie, returner, injury/availability or all context behavior.

minuteReconciliation.boundary: Minute-only reconciliation check on history-eligible held-out players. Opening-roster rookie and older-history returner proxies reserve minutes but are not scored. Unsupported incomplete teams are excluded; rates, injuries and availability are held fixed.

projections.boundary: Accounting and sensitivity tested; legacy veteran backtest below does not validate context-3-two-way-contracts. Rookie retrospective check omits target age without archived preseason bios and does not validate the live DOB-age correction.

tulipEvidence.boundary: Observational role-expansion evidence and robustness diagnostics are not predictive validation or causal identification.

devQuasiExperiment.interpretation: Frozen DEV quasi-experiment did not establish a positive win effect for BPM/box-score-based routing.

allocatorHistoricalReplay.reason: This section does not spend the pre-registered chronological TULIP holdouts or relabel the separate Projected Role MPG backtest as allocator validation.

tulipBeta.boundary: Pre-registered causal testing on 2015-16..2023-24 did NOT establish that either the play-more/play-less direction or the exact MPG deltas improve winning (reduced form -0.127 pts/SD, Anderson-Rubin 95% CI [-1.756, 1.021]). Treat as decision support, not a validated coaching prescription.

evidenceGrade.basis: count of TRAINING transitions with Team A season MPG within +/-3 of the candidate
evidenceGrade.status: CONVENIENCE LABEL, NOT A STATISTICAL GUARANTEE. The cutoffs were chosen for readability and have not been separately validated. The raw support count is always shown alongside.
evidenceGrade.inSeasonOverride: Incremental TULIP evidence: Unproven — season-MPG baseline recommended

projectedRoleMpg.boundary: This is a frozen role/workload projection with its own limited evidence; it is not physical capacity and its evidence does not validate TULIP Beta or the 2026-27 stat projection.

playerComparisons.boundary: Comparison similarity/blend fit is heuristic descriptive matching, not a calibrated probability or future-career prediction.

teamFit.boundary: Team Fit describes how a player profile addresses current roster needs; it is not a forecast of team wins or player performance.

crossLeague.boundary: Readiness/translation evidence comes from selected same-season dual-league samples; it does not establish NBA-career probability or general out-of-sample career accuracy.

forecastAdjustmentPolicy.note: Unconfigured or ambiguous external information does not silently rewrite forecasts.
